name: Opt-out categories from 2026: BLOCK PROMO and eight categories (Schedule-II item 1)

attrs.quote: all preferences registered under FULLY BLOCK category shall be migrated to BLOCK PROMO category within fifteen days
attrs.note: FULLY BLOCK is removed. BLOCK PROMO blocks promotional communications only; categories 1 to 8 are banking and finance, real estate, education, health, consumer goods and automobiles, communication and IT, tourism, food.
